item.title: UpToDay AI — 20 December 2025
item.description:
Stories & Sources
- 1. OpenAI launches GPT-5.2-Codex, a more capable coding model — https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-5-2-codex - 2. OpenAI publishes chain-of-thought monitorability framework and evaluation suite — https://openai.com/index/evaluating-chain-of-thought-monitorability - 3. NVIDIA joins DOE Genesis Mission to boost U.S. AI infrastructure and R&D — https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/nvidia-us-government-to-boost-ai-infrastructure-and-rd-investments/ - 4. NVIDIA releases RTX PRO 5000 72GB Blackwell GPU for desktop AI workflows — https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/rtx-pro-5000-72gb-blackwell-gpu/ - 5. Google adds AI-generated video verification to the Gemini app — https://blog.google/technology/ai/verify-google-ai-videos-gemini-app/ - 6. ElevenLabs unveils Eleven v3 (alpha) — a more expressive TTS model — https://elevenlabs.io/blog/eleven-v3
